chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Pee Wee Wiley, later Reverend Wiley
summary: Vocalist Pee Wee Wiley joins after the Texas Rangers band, and years later is assistant pastor in Watts.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Now as far as Pee Wee Wiley, he

wasn't anything particularly bad, but you never would dream that he developed to what he is doing now. He's a minister. Then he was nothing but devilment, but he could sing and he could holler and he finally woke up.

He left later--not with that bunch, but he left later for California, and went to California and then years later when I went there he had taken me out to dinner and had me-- he wasn't pastor, but a very good church out there in Watts, he was the assistant pastor.
